question: Reading the English alphabet from left to right, what is the 5th letter to the right of the 14th letter?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f253014ba128b7ad77b3c8d4e4833e79dfb592948c26e5534f9e8d4973167aed.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

14th letter is N

5th letter to the right of the 14th letter = N + 5 = S

S is the 5th letter to the right of the 14th letter.

Hence, ‘**S**’ is the correct answer.
